delta.insert: The city of Ashmark had stood for a thousand years, its white towers piercing the coastal mist like the fingers of a drowning giant.
It was known for three things: its fish markets, its shipyards, and the Mapmaker's Guild — the oldest and most prestigious cartographic institution in the known world.
Kira Valdris had worked in the Guild's attic for seven years, ever since her mother Elara had left her there as a girl of sixteen with nothing but a worn satchel and a cryptic note:

NOTE: This opening was discarded because it starts too slowly with worldbuilding exposition. The new opening (The Awakening) drops the reader directly into the action. Some elements from this draft — the Guild, the note from Elara — should be woven into flashbacks or dialogue later.
